title: cmHC: Balancing Stream Mixing in Hyper-Connections via Geometric Contraction
abstract: arXiv:2611.27193v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Manifold-constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) extends residual connections to multiple streams and stabilizes residual propagation by constraining stream-mixing residual matrices to the Birkhoff polytope, the set of doubly stochastic matrices. In this work, we investigate how to effectively mix residual streams within the Birkhoff polytope. We reveal a mixing trade-off: when under-mixed residual matrices stay close to the vertices of the Birkhoff polytope, hyper-connections will degenerate into a set of nearly independent streams; when over-mixed residual matrices are concentrated around the uniform barycenter of the polytope, streams will become less distinguishable from each other. We theoretically validate our findings by bounding the cumulative residual mixing, stream difference and gradient difference of mixing coefficients across layers. translated_title: cmHC：通过几何收缩平衡超连接中的流混合
translated_abstract: 流形约束超连接（mHC）将残差连接扩展到多个流，并通过将流混合残差矩阵约束到Birkhoff多胞形（即双随机矩阵的集合）来稳定残差传播。在这项工作中，我们研究如何在Birkhoff多胞形内有效地混合残差流。我们揭示了一种混合权衡：当混合不足的残差矩阵保持在Birkhoff多胞形顶点附近时，超连接将退化为一组几乎相互独立的流；而当过度混合的残差矩阵集中在多胞形的均匀重心附近时，各流之间将变得难以区分。我们通过给出跨层累积残差混合、流差异以及混合系数梯度差异的界，从理论上验证了我们的发现。受这些发现启发，我们提出了流形约束超连接的收缩方法（cmHC）……
tldr: 本文揭示了Birkhoff多胞形中残差流混合的权衡问题——混合不足会退化为独立流、过度混合会使流不可区分——并提出cmHC方法，利用几何收缩在多胞形内平衡流混合程度，同时从理论上给出了跨层累积混合、流差异与梯度差异的界。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals a mixing trade-off within the Birkhoff polytope for hyper-connections—under-mixing degenerates into independent streams while over-mixing makes streams indistinguishable—and proposes cmHC, which uses geometric contraction to balance stream mixing with theoretical bounds on cumulative residual mixing, stream difference, and gradient difference across layers.
